reviews.t: Sincere people, no-fluff preaching and faithful to the Word. Great church to visit! Meets in a sweet little chapel, not the red-brick house as pictured on Google.
Real sincere and loving people. The truth of the Bible is taught so hearers are able to live it in their lives.
Come and visit thus church next tim you're in Black Mountain. It's a small church with lots of love and a great preacher.
A lovely congregation, faithful to the Word of God.
You will not find more biblical and passionate and powerful preaching...anywhere.
